observations.claim: Nov 17 daily spot reference is $0.9562, range $0.9469-$0.9788; reported volume 341.22M with unit/timezone not established.
Binance XRPUSDT perpetual book showed $13.9M within ±0.5%, 1.03 bps spread, 49% bid share.
OI snapshots are $965M and $1.31B at different times and venue scopes; do not average.
Funding snapshots differ in sign and method; no single market consensus.
Nov 16 partial outflow and provisional inflow conflict by universe and finality.
Same-wallet exchange-labeled balances declined 139.2M XRP over seven days and 374.7M over 30 days.
Provider reports 31.10B XRP in live escrow and a maximum 1B unlock on Dec 1.
Ripple claims >1,700 institutional/corporate users and a near-$900M annualized product-revenue run-rate.
BNY says its custody platform supports XRP and RLUSD.
Reuters reports a strong dollar, increased December hike expectations and bitcoin weakness.

Investing.com Nov 17 daily row refreshed to $0.9636 in English and $0.9564 in Malay locale, with different reported volumes; earlier capture was $0.9562. The daily bar is live and timestamps are not synchronized.
Liqwall's later 20:22 UTC snapshot reports $956M XRP futures open interest, down 2.7% in 24 hours; its 30-day high was $1.49B on Nov 4.

XRP Insights reports +158,148 XRP for Nov 16 but excludes GXRP from flow totals while a data gap is corrected; CryptoKeyhole still reports a partial -5.197M XRP from two of four daily reporters at 20:45 UTC.

XRPL ledger reader at ledger 108395459 reports 31.1B XRP in 99 escrow objects, with 1B scheduled to become releasable Dec 1; about 70% of the last 12 monthly releases were re-escrowed, implying roughly 300M XRP/month net release.
Exchange-labeled balances include non-customer and wrapped-token reserves: 150.9M cbXRP on Base within Coinbase attribution and 327.4M Binance-Peg XRP on BNB Chain within Binance attribution.
Ripple's Oct 28 release reports 85 licenses, over $16T transactions enabled across its products in 2025, 1,700+ institutions and a near-$900M annualized product-revenue run-rate.

competing_hypotheses.test: Build timestamp-matched venue-level OI and liquidation history.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Exchange wallet decline reflects customer withdrawals or custody migration.
disconfirming_or_missing: Cold wallets, internal rotations and untracked destinations.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconcile exchange deposit/withdrawal and known wallet migration data.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Complete Nov 16 ETF flow sign is unknown.
disconfirming_or_missing: Different fund universe and missing issuer files.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconcile every issuer file by effective date and publication time.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Perpetual positioning is fragmented by venue.
support: Negative typical funding and positive Binance funding coexist.
competing_hypotheses.test: Normalize native venue funding and OI to matched intervals.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Custody adoption may not create XRP demand.
support: BNY supports XRP and RLUSD custody.
disconfirming_or_missing: No client balances or XRP purchases disclosed.
competing_hypotheses.test: Seek custody AUC, collateral usage, on-ledger flows and throughput.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Macro risk may weigh on crypto including XRP.
competing_hypotheses.test: Run leakage-safe event studies against BTC, DXY and yields.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The apparent ETF flow conflict is driven by fund coverage and publication timing, not necessarily true economic disagreement.
support: CryptoKeyhole is partial at 2/4 daily reporters; XRP Insights reports a positive total but excludes GXRP from flow totals.
disconfirming_or_missing: Issuer files for Bitwise, Franklin and GXRP are not all reconciled in this run.
competing_hypotheses.test: Retrieve each issuer's Nov 16 holdings file and compare publication times and included funds.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Dec 1 escrow release is not a 1B XRP supply shock; recent net release has been closer to 300M XRP/month.
support: Tracker reads 99 escrow objects and reports 70% re-escrowed over the last 12 releases.
disconfirming_or_missing: Future release and re-escrow decisions can differ; no forward commitment.
competing_hypotheses.test: Observe EscrowFinish and subsequent EscrowCreate transactions at ledger level for each release.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Exchange wallet balance decline overstates readily sellable float changes because labeled wallets include cold storage and wrapped-token reserves.
support: Coinbase includes cbXRP reserve and Binance includes Binance-Peg XRP reserve.
disconfirming_or_missing: Exact customer-owned versus exchange-owned balances remain unavailable.
competing_hypotheses.test: Separate native exchange hot/cold wallets, wrapped-token backing addresses and customer deposit/withdrawal ledgers.

data_quality.no_averaging_policy: Do not average OI, funding, ETF flow or order-book observations unless timestamp, market type, venue universe, units and methodology align.
data_quality.raw_receipt_status: No byte-exact raw HTTP receipts; rendered extracts only.
data_quality.locale_daily_bar_policy: Do not average Investing.com locale pages or treat a live daily row as a finalized close; capture exact retrieval time and exchange-native tick data.
data_quality.etf_flow_policy: Keep CryptoKeyhole partial 2/4 and XRP Insights included-universe Nov 16 flow separate; XRP Insights excludes GXRP from flow totals while correcting a data gap.
data_quality.escrow_policy: Model gross unlock, re-escrow and net release as separate features; never use scheduled 1B unlock as net supply.

predictions.reason: No byte-exact receipts, synchronized point-in-time history or completed leakage-safe out-of-sample evaluation.
